itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter18_verse3.title: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 18 Verse 3
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter18_verse3.introduction: This verse belongs to Chapter 18 of the Bhagavad Gita.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter18_verse3.scripture_text: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 18, Verse 3 teaches disciplined action, inner clarity, and devotion to the Divine as a path to liberation.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter18_verse3.philosophical_explanation: This verse contributes to Krishna's teaching on dharma, yoga, and liberation.
